description: Hurricane-blackout-heatwave compound hazard risk and resilience in a changing climate is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Ning Lin, Princeton University (princeton.edu). This project is to simulate post-hurricane heat wave and black out under different climatologies. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Hurricane ; Heatwave; Power Grids; Climate Change ; Resilience. Published 2022-01-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
